title: AI-Based Intraoral Videography for Automated Dental Inspection and Charting in Children With Mixed Dentition.
summary: The open-access primary article reports an AI classifier trained on annotated pediatric intraoral video and evaluated on 18 held-out videos (2,671 images) for automatic identification and charting of 44 tooth classes.
ai_technology: The learned classifier detects and labels 44 tooth classes from annotated intraoral video frames.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: The model identifies and charts teeth on held-out video frames and reports class-level confusion and accuracy.
evidence.unknown: 100 pediatric patients supplied data; 18 videos/2,671 images formed the reported test set.
evidence.ai_role: The learned classifier detects and labels 44 tooth classes from annotated intraoral video frames.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
